Chapter 6161: Just You?

Chapter 6161: Just You?

The blood of the emperors splashed out like flowers and rained downward. Their body, dao, and supreme dao fruits turned into ashes.

An emperor’s body had been turned into a golden avatar impervious to most weapons. The supreme dao fruits could be considered one of the hardest substances. However, neither lasted against the finger strike. A single move removed all traces of them from Sin.

Many big shots had expected Li Qiye’s victory but not in this particular manner. The domineering emperors appeared no different than insects and met their demise despite Transcendent’s involvement.

Geniuses worked their whole life to obtain a dao fruit. Thus, watching this was akin to having their dreams and ambitions destroyed. Despair and the futility of cultivation surfaced.

“Bam!” Li Qiye’s finger strike continued to sweep forward, crushing Immortal Suppression Gate.

The domain dispersed and cracks appeared throughout the dynasty; regions and palaces shattered from the shockwaves.

“He’s obliterating the dynasty…” Spectators became emotional. The destruction left an indelible mark in their memories.

“To death!” Transcendent appeared and summoned a domain.

He was furious after witnessing the destruction of the dynasty. His imperial aura surged upward like a storm capable of tearing stars apart. Nevertheless, his rage didn’t diminish his otherworldly appearance.

“Just you? Everyone else should just show up now.” Li Qiye said with a smile.

On a surface level, the spotlight should be on Transcendent. No one would give a second glance to Li Qiye. However, he was the dazzling center of the world.

Transcendent viewed him as a mighty foe while he viewed Transcendent as a trivial opponent. The difference in power was clear.

“Rumble!” Six figures appeared behind Transcendent, unleashing suffocating auras.

“Six emperors!” Everyone found it hard to breathe.

“Allmountain, Yangrune, Bloodsparrow, even Witch King and Golden Flower Emperor!” Many experts recognized them.

Six apex emperors were a sight to behold, especially with someone of Transcendent’s level. Normally, seeing one was rare enough, let alone six together. They could easily destroy all of Sin.

“Golden Flower and Witch King too?” Someone commented since the two weren’t from Immortal Dynasty.

Of course, Golden Flower’s Sky Tree City was under its jurisdiction, so she could be considered a part of it. As for Witch King, he should be a part of Phantom.

“Not unprepared, I see. Good, I can catch everyone all at once.” Li Qiye smiled, still not deterred by the six apex emperors.

His casual demeanor startled the opponents who knew of his terrifying power. Alas, they have never been so openly disdained by anyone. This was deeply humiliating.

Nevertheless, they were still apex emperors and maintained their composure.
